title: Welcome to SplatGPT
text: A static reference assistant for Splatoon 1, 2, and 3. This short tour covers the layout — use Next or Skip any time.

title: New chat
text: Start a fresh conversation here. Chats are saved automatically in this browser.

title: Current rotations
text: A dedicated page with every live rotation card — no chat needed. Each card shows maps, the mode icon, and a progress bar.

title: Recent chats
text: Reopen or delete past conversations. The trash icon appears on hover; Clear all wipes them.

title: Settings
text: Themes, accent colors, your optional sendou.ink API token, local-data controls, and the About page live here.

title: Game datasets
text: Switch the local dataset between Splatoon 1, 2, and 3. Rankings and rotations always reflect Splatoon 3.

title: Ask anything
text: Try “current X rotation”, “who was #247 last season?”, “best build for Splattershot”, or “what does Ninja Squid do?”.

title: Shortcuts
text: One-tap prompts for the most common lookups. That's the tour — good luck out there.
